acceptance_criteria: Accepted records can be read directly with the backend unavailable, and rebuilding a retrieval product preserves their bytes, identity, provenance, and meaning; the Template and another project receive no learned records.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-001. Original source attribution: U02; S01, The unit of memory is the owning project and Make the Sys4AI contract more important than the backend.
negative_requirements: Do not place learned records in the Template, another project, backend-only storage or harness memory.
requirements.outcome: Store the owning project's durable memory as human-readable, Git-trackable Markdown records under its own `MEMORY/`, independently of retrieval databases or harness memory.
requirements.title: Preserve project-owned canonical memory

acceptance_criteria: A conflicting, stale, or high-ranked memory cannot change current permissions, manager ownership, role eligibility, acceptance, completion, or a project's designated vocabulary; the current authoritative source is identified and inspected.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-002. Original source attribution: S01, Keep authority, evidence, memory, and indexes distinct and Harness memory remains complementary; L01; L03; L04.
negative_requirements: Memory cannot grant permissions or replace current governing sources.
requirements.outcome: Treat memory as a recorded interpretation whose applicability must be checked against current governing instructions, canonical Task state, role pairs, requirements, plans, and direct evidence.
requirements.title: Preserve the authority of current sources

acceptance_criteria: Existing Task and role operations remain usable with memory absent, disabled, or unavailable, and memory integration introduces no parallel authority for execution or completion.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-003. Original source attribution: S01, Make the Sys4AI contract more important than the backend; L01; L03.
negative_requirements: No memory scheduler, second execution ledger, mandatory service or mandatory memory-manager role.
requirements.outcome: Implement memory as a thin capability that can inform existing workflows without becoming their scheduler, execution ledger, mandatory service, or separate manager.
requirements.title: Keep execution independent of memory

acceptance_criteria: Each reusable artifact has an identified source collection, while learned root records, credentials, local configuration values, and runtime data are absent from reusable sources and starter assets.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-004. Original source attribution: U02; S01, Reusable sources and project-local files; L01.
negative_requirements: No learned records, credentials or local runtime values in reusable assets.
requirements.outcome: Own reusable memory schemas, policy, templates, and profiles in `MEMORY-depo/`, executable skill behavior in `SKILLS-depo/memory/`, and reusable role responsibilities in `ROLES-depo/`.
requirements.title: Separate reusable definitions from learned content

acceptance_criteria: Valid examples cover all five types and non-Task work; malformed identity, unsupported schema/type/state, unresolved required placeholders, or incompatible project ownership fail validation without fabricating Task or role identifiers.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-005. Original source attribution: S01, Durable records with explicit scope and provenance.
requirements.outcome: Validate the record types `decision`, `finding`, `experiment`, `lesson`, and exceptional `handoff`, with stable identity, owning project, title, lifecycle, creation/modification chronology, applicability, limitations, confidence, source references, and relevant origin/provenance metadata.
requirements.title: Define a durable record contract

acceptance_criteria: Missing evidence, false identifiers, unexplained digest mismatches, and unsupported performed-work claims cannot become unqualified active findings; an accepted design can be recorded as a design decision without claiming implementation, and an observed failure retains its conditions and limits.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-006. Original source attribution: S01, Durable records with explicit scope and provenance and Capture durable knowledge at the right point.
requirements.outcome: Validate source locators and digests, real Task/execution/role references when present, and the evidence supporting a proposed memory's stated claim and confidence before active publication.
requirements.title: Require evidence appropriate to the claim

acceptance_criteria: Default shared recall returns eligible active records; requested historical reads clearly label other states, and superseded or retracted material is not silently presented as the controlling current conclusion.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-007. Original source attribution: S01, Durable records with explicit scope and provenance and Supersession, staleness, and correction; U03.
requirements.outcome: Support `draft`, `active`, `superseded`, and `retracted` records with checked transitions, explicit supersession links, and retained reasons for correction or retraction.
requirements.title: Make lifecycle explicit

acceptance_criteria: Retrieval identifies mismatched source versions and relevant supersession; a reviewer can distinguish historical retention, reaffirmed applicability, supersession, and retraction without relying only on recency or ranking.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-008. Original source attribution: S01, Supersession, staleness, and correction and Prefer hybrid retrieval, but validate exact sources.
requirements.outcome: Detect changed or unavailable cited sources and expose the resulting uncertainty without treating a digest change as proof that the historical conclusion is false.
requirements.title: Expose staleness and applicability

acceptance_criteria: Capture distinguishes design approval, performed work, verified outcomes, failed work, and cancelled work; duplicate or unsupported proposed lessons are not automatically activated, and ordinary conversation produces no automatic transcript or memory archive.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-009. Original source attribution: S01, Capture durable knowledge at the right point and Phase 1.
requirements.outcome: Capture concise, reusable decisions, observations, experiments, lessons, and negative results when their evidence and scope justify reuse, rather than automatically summarizing every session or response.
requirements.title: Capture useful knowledge selectively

acceptance_criteria: A handoff memory links to its owning evidence and labels historical context; it does not duplicate live next-step state, establish a running manager, or cause a Task to resume.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-010. Original source attribution: S01, Keep handoffs in the Task system unless they add lasting knowledge; L03.

requirements.title: Reserve handoff memories for lasting context

requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-011. Original source attribution: S01, Configuration owned by Sys4AI; L01; L02.

acceptance_criteria: Distinct sentinel records in two isolated project fixtures never cross retrieval or publication boundaries; root defaults exclude `Projects/**`, including attempted indirect access through aliases, and registration alone grants no memory access.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-012. Original source attribution: S01, The unit of memory is the owning project and Configuration owned by Sys4AI.

requirements.title: Enforce project and path isolation

acceptance_criteria: Default general-corpus exclusions cover child projects, Tasks, active and legacy roles, reusable/reference collections, Git/environment/runtime/build directories, and credential/secret paths; authorized exact Task or role reads remain available outside general retrieval, and exceptions require a deliberate scoped profile.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-013. Original source attribution: S01, Configuration owned by Sys4AI and Research documents, LaTeX, PDFs, and retrieval.
negative_requirements: No automatic inclusion of Tasks, active/legacy roles, reusable collections, runtime state or secrets in the general corpus.
requirements.outcome: Separate canonical memory from an allowlisted source corpus covering the project's `README.md`, permitted `docs/` Markdown, and permitted `research/` Markdown, TeX, PDF, and HTML, with declared exclusions applied during ingestion and retrieval.
requirements.title: Define an explicit source corpus

acceptance_criteria: A reviewer can distinguish a recorded conclusion from supporting or contradictory evidence and reach the relevant file, section, page, or label; a normalized document or search result is never automatically promoted into accepted memory.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-014. Original source attribution: S01, Source documents are evidence, not automatically memories.
requirements.outcome: Identify whether each retrieval result is a curated memory or an allowed source document and return the locators and provenance needed to inspect its actual bytes.
requirements.title: Distinguish memory results from source evidence

requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-015. Original source attribution: S01, Retained alternatives and human interfaces, Prefer hybrid retrieval, but validate exact sources, and Phase 1.
requirements.outcome: Support direct reads and deterministic lexical retrieval for exact identifiers, paths, error codes, and equation labels when a semantic backend is disabled, unavailable, or inappropriate for a read-only operation.
requirements.title: Provide a deterministic lexical fallback

acceptance_criteria: The pilot records results for representative exact and conceptual queries against known relevant records, distinguishes actual retrieval modes, and reports missed or misleading results without treating ranking as evidence of truth.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-016. Original source attribution: U02; S01, Basic Memory remains the preferred first backend and Prefer hybrid retrieval, but validate exact sources; B02.
requirements.outcome: Include Basic Memory hybrid retrieval in the pilot so conceptual queries can complement exact-term lookup while retaining lifecycle, project, provenance, and version constraints.
requirements.title: Evaluate combined exact and conceptual retrieval

acceptance_criteria: Read-only checks leave governed file bytes and modification timestamps unchanged and do not initialize databases, synchronize files, repair indexes, install packages, download models, or enable cloud routing; a permitted direct-read fallback or an explicit limitation is returned instead.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-017. Original source attribution: S01, Task activation must not become a memory side effect and Phase 1; L03.
negative_requirements: Reads cannot initialize, synchronize, repair, install, download, write timestamps or route to cloud services.
requirements.outcome: Keep memory `search`, `read`, `validate`, and `health` non-mutating, including when configuration or backend state is missing or stale.
requirements.title: Preserve strict read-only behavior

acceptance_criteria: The interface distinguishes read-only inspection, bounded proposal output, canonical publication, derived-index rebuilding, and recovery; no read operation silently performs a maintenance operation, and mutations without their required scope are rejected.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-018. Original source attribution: S01, Phase 1 and Publication, concurrency, and recovery.
requirements.outcome: Expose documented operations for `search`, `read`, `propose`, `publish`, `supersede`, `retract`, `validate`, `reindex`, and `health`, with each operation's write boundary and required scope explicit.
requirements.title: Separate inspection from maintenance operations

acceptance_criteria: Sensitive fixture content is excluded at ingestion, retrieval, and publication boundaries, and an instruction embedded in a note or source cannot expand permissions or trigger an external action.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-019. Original source attribution: U01; S01, Configuration owned by Sys4AI, Supersession, staleness, and correction, and Prefer hybrid retrieval, but validate exact sources; L01.
negative_requirements: No credentials, unnecessary personal information, hidden reasoning, full transcripts or instruction-derived authority.
requirements.outcome: Exclude credentials, unnecessary personal data, hidden reasoning, full transcripts, and unauthorized project content from records and retrieval products, and treat retrieved instructions as source data.
requirements.title: Keep secrets and source instructions out of authority

acceptance_criteria: Publication checks the actual publisher, current project/execution ownership where applicable, granted memory scope, reviewed content, evidence, and expected record version; out-of-scope, stale, or unconfirmed publishers fail, and a host cannot compete with an activated manager's assigned scope.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-020. Original source attribution: U03; S01, Add memory responsibilities to existing roles and Publication, concurrency, and recovery; L01; L03.
negative_requirements: No competing host writer within an activated manager scope or authority inferred from a role title.

requirements.title: Apply the agreed publication authority

acceptance_criteria: A child's useful proposed note is inspectable by its authorized Director or manager, but it does not become shared recall or confer canonical Task, role-index, or unrestricted memory write rights before approved publication.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-021. Original source attribution: S01, Add memory responsibilities to existing roles and Capture durable knowledge at the right point; L03; L04.

requirements.title: Keep child outputs as proposals

acceptance_criteria: Indexing and retrieval preserve canonical note, Task, and role bytes; either a verified non-mutating canonical read profile or a derived projection is used, and actual exposed tools are checked for canonical write bypasses.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-022. Original source attribution: S01, Basic Memory remains the preferred first backend and Publication, concurrency, and recovery.
negative_requirements: No unrestricted backend writer is exposed to ordinary children or pointed at canonical memory.
requirements.outcome: Keep canonical memory publication under the Sys4AI helper and prevent ordinary backend tools from providing an unrestricted alternate writer to solvers or other unauthorized actors.
requirements.title: Prevent alternate backend publication routes

acceptance_criteria: Concurrent or stale writes produce a reported conflict with no lost update; a human edit is detected before replacement, unrelated notes remain intact, and a failed pre-publication check leaves canonical content unchanged.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-023. Original source attribution: S01, Publication, concurrency, and recovery.
requirements.outcome: Validate single-record changes before atomic publication, serialize conflicting writes with a project-local memory lock, and require the expected prior digest for an existing record.
requirements.title: Publish single-record changes without lost updates

acceptance_criteria: Interruption at each publication boundary yields a report of the actual committed state; recovery preserves identities and history without duplicate records, lost reasons, silent half-supersession, or an unsupported claim of full success.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-024. Original source attribution: S01, Publication, concurrency, and recovery.
requirements.outcome: Make supersession and other multi-record memory changes recoverable, using a bounded transaction or deterministic append-first representation with attributable idempotent retries.
requirements.title: Recover multi-record lifecycle changes accurately

acceptance_criteria: A failed required memory deliverable remains an unmet criterion; failure of optional later capture is reported separately, and retry never reopens a terminal Task, relaunches agents, or repeats an already committed Task event merely to repair memory.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved outcome and acceptance boundary in REQ-025. Original source attribution: S01, Publication, concurrency, and recovery; L03.
negative_requirements: Memory recovery cannot replay Task events, relaunch agents or reopen terminal Tasks.
requirements.outcome: Reference actual memory publication results through permitted Task evidence/response mechanisms without replaying execution or manufacturing Task acceptance to repair a note.
